A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoLOR research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A.1–A.10 support reliable comparison; the shorter v5 reflects reflow rather than missing material.

before.justification: V4 reports original experiments on SUN397, CIFAR100, and Amazon Reviews, plus Gaussian simulations in Appendix A.10 and Tables 25–26.

after.justification: V5 retains these original benchmark experiments and Gaussian simulation results, including the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The constrained learning rules, shared representation, multiple novelty heads, training objective, and head-selection procedure remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same scene and subtype shifts on SUN397 and CIFAR100, sentiment shifts on Amazon Reviews, comparisons without background shift, and Gaussian separability scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across corresponding main and appendix experiments, including DD, uPU, nnPU, BODA, ARPL, CAC, PULSE, SHOT, ZOC, ANNA, and the joint-learning comparison variants.

E3.justification: Experimental splits, backbones, metrics, threshold settings, search grids, and synthetic training/test sample sizes are unchanged. Revised sample-size conditions concern the theoretical guarantee, not the experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The joint-learning ablations, novel-class proportion analysis, FPR and search-grid sensitivity studies, and Gaussian angular-separation and signal-strength tests retain the same evidence. Figure 4 is relocated, not newly added.

E5.justification: The five repetitions per novel-class identity, distinct random seeds, and reporting of averages and standard deviations remain unchanged in A.7.1–A.7.2 and the result tables.

E6.justification: Empirical table entries and plotted findings are unchanged after matching relocated material. For example, Table 2 retains CoLOR's SUN397 AUROC of 0.98 ± 0.02, AUPRC of 0.91 ± 0.09, and OSCR of 0.81 ± 0.04.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 and its A.2 restatement add N_S >= N_T and alpha >= 1/N_T, replacing r_eta/r_mu <= 4/N with r_eta/r_mu <= 1/[8(1 + sqrt(N_T N_T,1))]. Proposition 2 revises several norm and sample-size bounds, and the theorem proof changes its supporting inequalities and feasibility argument. These substantially revise the admissible regime and repair incompatible conditions in the earlier main theorem.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same principal contributions: constrained OSDA under background shift, theoretical superiority in an overparameterized setting, scalable CoLOR, and empirical robustness when novel classes are rare.

C2.justification: The discussions of shared representations, background-shift effects, imperfect separability, search-grid applicability, and future limitations are unchanged. The formal assumption revisions do not introduce corresponding new interpretive discussion.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, dataset construction instructions, hyperparameters in Table 7, and code-access information are retained without substantive revision.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to earlier constrained-learning and OSDA research, and bibliography are unchanged.

P1.justification: Appendix A.2 adds and rewrites localized explanatory prose around the revised proof inequalities. The main narrative, terminology, and section organization remain substantially identical.

P2.justification: Appendix tables and surrounding text are redistributed: Table 7 now shares a page with Table 8, and Figure 4 moves from v4 page 38 to v5 page 39. Figure designs, table structures, captions, and plotted content are retained.

improvement.justification: V4's Theorem 1 has incompatible bounds: r_eta/r_mu <= 4/N and r_mu <= sqrt(N_T,0)/2 imply r_eta <= 2/sqrt(N_T), contradicting r_eta >= 16/sqrt(N_T). V5 replaces the ratio bound with one admitting a nonempty parameter regime and revises the supporting proposition and derivation. Removing this vacuity substantially improves a central theoretical contribution; the method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
